右上角「多選」可以一次改標籤、節日、類型、尺寸、系列、品牌、產地、購入日期、到貨: Tap “Select” at the top right to change tags, holiday, type, size, series, brand, origin, purchase date or arrival date for many items at once.
編輯單品時，欄位標題後面的「!」點一下會跳出說明。同一個品牌推出的系列，可以填在: When editing an item, tap the “!” after a field name for an explanation. A brand’s series goes in the optional “Series” field above the brand (search finds it too); works and events (e.g. Love and Deepspace) are easiest as tags.
出售貼文可以選要不要寫品牌、系列、作品、購買管道、產地，還有無菸、無寵物環境。: In the sale post you choose whether to show the brand, series, work, where you bought it and origin, plus smoke-free or pet-free home.
預購、運送中的娃衣記在「購買中」，可以標尺寸、系列和品牌；同一團買很多件，用「一: Pre-orders and items in shipping go in “On order”, with size, series and brand; for many items from one group order, use “Add several” and write one per line.
購買中會把快到家的排在最上面：已到貨、運送中、製作中、已付款、開團中，同一個進度: “On order” puts what arrives soonest at the top: arrived, shipping, in production, paid, group buy open, then by expected arrival date. When the list gets long, use the search box to find a name, series, brand or shop.
「多選」可以一次改進度、預計到貨、尺寸、系列、品牌，到貨的一起拿去建檔。: “Select” lets you change stage, expected arrival, size, series and brand at once, and file everything that has arrived together.
AI 功能每個月 1 號會給一次額度，免費版也有；用完可以用點數。右上角的 ✦: AI features get a fresh allowance on the 1st of every month, free plan included; when it runs out you can use points. Tap ✦ points at the top right (members: bottom of “My membership”) to see what’s left this month, buy points or enter a redeem code.
語言可以選繁體中文、簡體中文或英文，預設跟著手機。只會換畫面上的字，衣櫃裡的資料: Language: Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese or English; it follows your phone by default. Only on-screen text changes — your wardrobe data stays the same.
外觀可以選淺色、深色，或跟著手機自動切換。: Appearance: light, dark, or follow your phone automatically.
「我住在」選你住的國家，足跡和旅行回憶會照這個算；下面可以選記帳幣別，花費、購買: “I live in” sets your country for footprints and trip memories; below it you can pick the currency for spending, order prices and screenshot import conversion.
「衣櫃類別」可以新增自己的類別（例如 和服、泳裝），不常用的也可以隱藏；「娃衣尺: “Closet categories” lets you add your own categories (e.g. kimono, swimwear) and hide ones you don’t use; “Clothing sizes” lets you add sizes such as OB11 or BJD.
「貼圖製作」可以選每次詢問，或固定用點選去背、簡易去背、AI 出圖。: “Stickers” lets you ask every time, or always use tap to cut, simple cut-out or AI image.
提醒會出現在首頁；開了手機通知，也會跳通知給你。用 App 的話，提醒會在當天早: Reminders appear on the home screen, and with notifications on you’ll get alerts too. In the app they arrive at 9 a.m. on the day, even when the app is closed; on the web, add Wawa Closet to your Home Screen first and alerts show when you open it.

你的照片和資料都只存在這支手機裡，不會上傳到任何地方。記得偶爾備份一下，就像幫娃: Your photos and data stay only on this phone and are never uploaded anywhere. Remember to back up now and then — just like taking a keepsake photo of your doll.
